1956 Chevrolet Car


From Dakota Digital

These LED tail lights work with your existing wiring harness, lens and housing**, whether that's the original wiring or a newer replacement harness.

Included: LED brake and tail light modules for both the left and right side, plus wiring and moisture-resistant crimp connectors.

LAT-NR200 - Includes the following product:

  • 2 LED modules
  • 4 moisture resistant connectors
  • 2 ring terminals for grounding

Dakota Digital LED Tail Light Modules are backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.

**Housing and lens aren't included. If yours can't be cleaned up or repaired, replace them before installing.
